slice.name: duplicate_event_id_payload_conflict_after_restart
slice.purpose: Continue the existing two-frame e4b->e5 restart/idempotency fixture with exactly one conflicting replay: same event_id e4b, different patch payload, and a stale original prev_chain. Test that reconstructed event-id lookup rejects the payload conflict before any prev_chain acceptance or state mutation.
slice.canonicalization: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and separators ',' ':'; event payload digest is SHA-256 of canonical event JSON; commit digest is SHA-256 of canonical body {event,event_payload_digest,prev_chain}; complete frame adds commit_digest and one trailing newline.

decision_trace.step_2_payload_digest_compare: incoming digest differs from stored e4b digest

slice.tested_scope: Deterministic small text state; exactly two previously validated complete frames e4b then e5; one reconstructed two-entry event index after restart; and one replay using the existing event_id e4b with a different patch payload and stale original prev_chain. This establishes explicit conflict rejection and no second effect in this exact fixture only. It does not establish arbitrarily long/corrupted journals, partial-tail recovery, compaction/tombstones, concurrent writers, lock-free progress, fairness, semantic model-weight adaptation, or indefinite repository availability.

Repository contents API is used only for lightweight durable state transport/readback. The tested mechanism requires no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifacts/LFS/packages, cloud credits, external model/API credits, protected authority, manual user execution, scheduler mutation, or incremental monetary cost.

exact_continuation: Next invocation: stay on the same durable-adaptation journal leaf and test one crash-tail recovery case only. Starting from the validated complete e4b->e5 journal, append one intentionally truncated third-frame byte prefix with a new event_id e6, then reconstruct from durable bytes. Require the scanner to accept exactly the two complete frames, reject/ignore the incomplete tail without applying e6, reconstruct the e4b/e5 index, and preserve the post-e5 state digest and chain exactly.
